summary: Equity Bancshares, Inc., a Kansas bank holding company, announced via Form 8-K that it entered into an Agreement and Plan of Reorganization on September 2, 2026, to acquire Lincoln Bancorp, an Iowa corporation parent of Lincoln Savings Bank. Under the agreement, a newly formed Iowa merger subsidiary will merge into Lincoln, with Lincoln surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary, followed by a second-step merger into Equity Bancshares and eventual consolidation of Lincoln Savings Bank into Equity Bank. Lincoln stockholders can elect to receive stock, cash, or a mix per share, with consideration adjustments based on capital levels, merger costs, credit costs, and a BaaS platform wind-down condition. The boards of both companies unanimously approved the transaction; no per-share price, premium, or advisor information was disclosed. Watch for regulatory approvals and closing conditions, including minimum capital delivery thresholds.
